actions.name: Thump
actions.description: As a standard action, the mech drives the thumper into a surface, dealing high damage with a B & So damage type to all creatures and objects within the mech's reach who would feel the vibration.

description.value:
A massive counterweight is propelled into the end of the thumper's gauntlet as it connects with its target, creating a one-two punch.
